content: The listed copies of Qābiliyyat (Persian; variant title Aʿmāl u Afʿāl) begin with MS 5423 ff. 175b-77a (Fatih, Süleymaniye, Istanbul, copied Rajab-Ramaḍān 842/January-March 1439); the entry lists no copy in MS Majlis 10196 (a MS Majlis 10004 pp. 262-65, copied in Yazd 903-4/1497-98, is a different manuscript).
